summary: A stuck job no longer holds back your daily collection.

fixes.title: Stuck jobs no longer block the daily run
fixes.text: SecurityInsight now stops its own jobs that show no sign of life for 15 to 30 minutes, so the waiting run starts. A job that is still working is never stopped.

fixes.title: Building the CI list survives a hiccup
fixes.text: A temporary database answer while building the CI list is now retried, so a long build no longer has to start again.

fixes.title: No more warning about support requests
fixes.text: The update again makes sure support requests can be delivered. The warning shown on every run for the last few days is gone.
